name: Hearthstone Firearms Hunter's Precision HHP-7 'Longreach'
description:
The HHP-7 Longreach is a bolt-action precision rifle designed for frontier hunters and settlement defenders who need accuracy at distance without electronic assistance. The weapon chambers .308 brass-cased — a legacy cartridge that Hearthstone perpetuates because it is manufactured by dozens of small ammunition producers across GLMZ. The bolt-action operation is slower than semi-automatic alternatives but provides a rigid lockup that maximizes accuracy.

The Longreach comes with a fixed 10x optical scope of surprisingly good quality, manufactured in-house by Hearthstone's optics division. The scope features a ballistic-drop compensating reticle calibrated specifically for the .308 at standard atmospheric conditions, allowing holdover adjustments without turret dialing. The rifle's walnut stock is hand-checkered — an anachronistic touch that Hearthstone maintains because their customers value craftsmanship.

At Φ1,200, the Longreach provides genuine precision capability at a price that frontier communities can afford. Its bolt action and legacy cartridge are limitations by military standards, but for a settlement defender engaging threats at 500-700 meters, the rifle delivers. The HHP-7 has put more game on more tables and deterred more threats at more settlement gates than any smart-scoped wonder weapon ever manufactured.
specifications:
caliber: .308 brass-cased
effective_range: 700m
rate_of_fire: Bolt-action (8-10 rpm skilled)
magazine_capacity: 5 rounds (internal)
weight: 4.0 kg
tactical_use: The Longreach provides frontier precision capability independent of any electronic or corporate infrastructure. Its bolt action and legacy cartridge ensure function with widely available ammunition and no maintenance beyond basic cleaning. The BDC reticle allows rapid engagement at known distances without the complexity of dialing turrets. In settlement defense, the HHP-7's accuracy at 500+ meters creates a deterrent zone that casual aggressors respect.
cultural_context: The Longreach is the frontier precision rifle — carried by hunters, ranchers, and settlement watchers who learned marksmanship on analog equipment and see no reason to change. Its hand-checkered walnut stock is a deliberate statement: this is a weapon made by people for people, not stamped by machines for quotas. Hearthstone's frontier customers develop multi-generational relationships with their Longreach rifles, passing them from parent to child.
story_hooks: A Longreach that has been in one family for three generations was used to make a 700-meter shot that stopped a corporate land survey. The shot didn't hit anyone — it hit the survey equipment. The message was clear.

Hearthstone's hand-checkering team is retiring, and no one has apprenticed to replace them. The last generation of hand-finished Longreach rifles is in production, and collectors are buying them faster than Hearthstone can make them.

physical_description.visual_profile: A classically-proportioned bolt-action rifle with deliberate anachronistic elegance—long barrel, graceful stock curve, and purposeful simplicity. The silhouette reads as 'hunting heritage' rather than military aggression, despite its precision lethality. The fixed scope mounted atop gives it a purposeful, austere look.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 112 cm | Barrel length: 61 cm | Stock depth: 8 cm | Scope: 30 cm length, 5 cm diameter
physical_description.weight_description: Substantial but balanced—4.0 kg feels purposeful in the hands, neither feather-light nor unwieldy. The weight sits forward of the grip, encouraging stable shouldering during long-distance aiming.
physical_description.primary_material: Steel barrel and receiver, hardwood (walnut) furniture, aluminum scope body. No polymer—materials chosen for longevity and thermal stability.
physical_description.finish: Barrel: matte blued steel with micro-worn patina at edges. Stock: oil-rubbed walnut with subtle sheen, hand-checkered surfaces visible under sidelight. Scope: anodized aluminum in gunmetal gray with light surface oxidation suggesting honest use.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: warm medium brown (walnut) and deep blue-black (steel). Accents: brushed aluminum scope body, brass cartridge casings visible at the internal magazine well.
physical_description.grip_texture: Walnut stock is hand-checkered with diagonal diamond pattern—tactile, gripping texture that prevents slip even with cold or gloved hands. Smooth swell at the grip. Bolt knob is knurled steel, slightly cool to touch.
distinctive_features: Hand-checkered walnut stock with visible grain variation
Fixed 10x optical scope with BDC reticle and crosshair illumination
Exposed bolt carrier with knurled operation handle
Deep bluing on barrel with micro-edge wear suggesting field use
Sling swivel studs mounted at foregrip and stock heel
Scope has fine adjustment turrets (elevation/windage) but BDC design minimizes dialing necessity
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: HEARTHSTONE FIREARMS and HHP-7 LONGREACH stamped in clean serif font on the barrel flat forward of the scope. Serial number engraved on the receiver. Small Hearthstone phoenix logo (stylized rising bird) inlayed in the walnut stock just behind the grip.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained and honest-worn. No cosmetic surface damage, but the bluing shows fingerprint oil marks and the walnut displays subtle handling wear on the grip and foregrip. The scope lens has dust coating but is clear—a tool in regular, respected use rather than safe-queen display piece.
